title: Your visit to Poland
text:
Hi Jake,

Great news – you're coming to Poland! I'm so happy you can visit me in May. Here's some information about your trip.

When you arrive at the airport in Gdańsk, take bus number 210 to the city centre. It takes about thirty minutes and the ticket is cheap. You can buy it from the machine at the bus stop – it takes cards. I'll wait for you at the last stop, next to the main railway station.

You're going to stay with my family. My mum is a great cook, so I hope you're hungry! My little brother Kuba is ten and he's very excited because he wants to practise his English with you.

I've got lots of plans for us. On the first day we're going to walk around the old town and go up the tower of St Mary's Church. The view from the top is amazing, but there are more than four hundred steps! On Saturday we can go to the beach in Sopot. It's still too cold to swim in May, but we can walk on the pier.

Please bring comfortable shoes and a warm jacket – the weather can change quickly here.

See you soon!
Bartek
